description: Builds a privacy-minimized local-review release of Illinois SOS Goodstanding/Reinstated corporations and LLCs from one common-run-date set of five operator-supplied official fixed-width files, with no network acquisition and no physical-site inference.
redirect_policy: No HTTP requests or redirects are permitted. Inputs must be operator-supplied files whose resolved real paths remain inside datahub.
retry: Do not retry validation, schema, join, run-date, path, archive, duplicate-identity, count, or quality-gate failures. A failed operator-supplied file set must be replaced or corrected explicitly.
checkpoint: Validate and minimize all five complete daily files into one unpublished run-scoped staging release. Publish only after common run-date, exact-count, exact-join, privacy, postal, provenance, and checksum verification; current.json changes atomically after independent verification.
idempotency: The common source RUN DATE and ordered SHA-256 values of all five exact operator inputs identify the source release. Entity kind plus the exact eight-digit Illinois SOS file number identifies a provisional organization candidate.
cancellation: Stop parsing and normalization cooperatively, close writers, retain no claim of a publishable release, and leave the prior current.json pointer unchanged.
retention_profile: Retain only privacy-minimized source fields and normalized artifacts as local-review-only. Do not retain officer, agent, manager/member, stock, finance, or other excluded person-linked fields.
